generalRules: No implementation edit may start before the active Development Guard manifest has been generated and read.
The Plan Before Code gate must pass before editing tracked implementation files.
If the actual diff expands into a new subsystem or activates additional Known Failures, stop and regenerate/review the plan.
After each coherent edit batch, run the Edit-Time Guard and Incremental Replay before continuing.
Final CI/Quality Gate remains mandatory; development-time prevention does not replace final proof.
Every short or broad intent matcher must keep at least one positive target example and one lexically similar non-target example in regression coverage.

intentMatchers.pattern: incident|hibabejelent|hiba bejelent|bug report|self-healing|self healing|öngyógy|triage|repair request|javítási kérés|observability incident

SQ-KF-001.preventiveDirective: Identify the canonical owner before changing behavior. Extend or repair that owner; do not introduce a local controller, renderer, engine or workflow that duplicates it.
forbiddenApproaches: parallel controller/engine/workflow for an existing shared capability
template-local or module-local patch that becomes a second authority

SQ-KF-002.preventiveDirective: Resolve the accepted navigation/entrypoint authority before changing route targets. Preserve existing accepted entrypoints unless the task explicitly supersedes them.
forbiddenApproaches: changing a route target from a screenshot symptom alone
adding a second route path for the same capability

SQ-KF-003.preventiveDirective: Separate deployment/protection reachability from application health. Require application/runtime evidence before treating a preview as valid.
forbiddenApproaches: treating Vercel READY/302/protection UI as application proof

SQ-KF-004.preventiveDirective: When a test fails, inspect the evidence path before changing runtime contracts. Repair the harness when the harness is wrong.
forbiddenApproaches: weakening runtime safety to satisfy a defective acceptance harness
requiredBeforeEdit: Review invariant authority: SQ-AUTH-004, SQ-AUTH-006, SQ-AUTH-007

SQ-KF-005.preventiveDirective: Preserve a separate human/live acceptance requirement for visual and interactive surfaces; automated green is necessary but not sufficient.
forbiddenApproaches: declaring visual acceptance from CI alone

SQ-KF-006.preventiveDirective: Treat runtime code and required production schema as one release unit. Prove target schema compatibility before runtime deployment.
forbiddenApproaches: deploying runtime that assumes unapplied production migrations

SQ-KF-007.preventiveDirective: Keep content publication separate from storefront access authorization. Resolve lifecycle/access authority before exposing a published page.
forbiddenApproaches: equating published content with public storefront access

SQ-KF-008.preventiveDirective: Reconcile against the current release base before release proof. Do not reuse stale feature-head evidence as current production evidence.
forbiddenApproaches: deploying a stale stacked branch over a newer main

SQ-KF-009.preventiveDirective: Keep fresh-install evidence and existing-production schema parity as separate proofs.
forbiddenApproaches: treating Fresh Install PASS as proof that the live database is current

SQ-KF-010.preventiveDirective: Provision and verify all acceptance fixtures explicitly. Do not depend on hidden mutable environment state.
forbiddenApproaches: assuming named coupons/providers/products already exist in the target environment

SQ-KF-011.preventiveDirective: Compose the canonical shared capability into the surface; never duplicate account, commerce, support or platform behavior locally.
forbiddenApproaches: second account/auth/commerce/support implementation inside a template or module

SQ-KF-012.preventiveDirective: Design mobile interaction as its own responsive composition where required; do not merely shrink desktop density.
forbiddenApproaches: desktop interaction compressed into mobile without interaction-mode change

SQ-KF-013.preventiveDirective: Prove that the guard selector activated every relevant failure class. A green result is invalid if applicability selection is incomplete.
forbiddenApproaches: accepting PASS without guard-selection evidence

SQ-KF-014.preventiveDirective: Persist unknown/review-required failure intake until explicit disposition; never allow a transient CI artifact to be the sole record.
forbiddenApproaches: silently dropping unresolved failure intake between cycles

SQ-KF-015.preventiveDirective: Name the authoritative state transition explicitly: source, persisted draft/package and runtime are separate. Prove the intended materialization step.
forbiddenApproaches: assuming source edits automatically update persisted or live state

SQ-KF-016.preventiveDirective: Use one canonical responsive/workspace authority. Base layout decisions on the product viewport/workspace contract, not host-device heuristics or compensating zoom.
forbiddenApproaches: navigator.userAgent as responsive authority
fixed zoom/scale as a substitute for layout ownership

SQ-KF-017.preventiveDirective: Resolve tenant and operating context before capability, route or mutation selection; fail closed on null or ambiguity.
forbiddenApproaches: first-tenant fallback
null-to-default tenant selection

SQ-KF-018.preventiveDirective: Encode every required migration/grant/symbol as part of the target environment baseline and prove it before runtime use.
forbiddenApproaches: assuming staging/production has a dependency because source or another environment has it

SQ-KF-019.preventiveDirective: Keep price, stock, order identity, release and compatibility truth server-owned. Presentation may display, never invent or override.
forbiddenApproaches: client clock/template copy/demo state used as commerce truth
requiredBeforeEdit: Keep regression authority available: tests/commerce-pricing.test.ts, tests/core-checkout-quote.test.ts, tests/order-lifecycle-contracts.test.ts

SQ-KF-020.preventiveDirective: Keep evidence promotion independently reachable. The command that promotes accepted evidence may not require that same new evidence to already be accepted.
forbiddenApproaches: circular golden/evidence promotion gate
requiredBeforeEdit: Review invariant authority: SQ-AUTH-015, SQ-AUTH-004, SQ-AUTH-007

SQ-KF-021.preventiveDirective: Use canonical machine identity for Support Knowledge records; retain human IDs only as retrieval aliases.
forbiddenApproaches: using a reused human-readable SKB ID as the sole machine key
requiredBeforeEdit: Review invariant authority: SQ-AUTH-016, SQ-AUTH-010, SQ-AUTH-007

SQ-KF-022.preventiveDirective: Load and read the active Development Guard before the first code edit, then run Edit-Time Guard and Incremental Replay after each coherent change batch.
forbiddenApproaches: coding first and consulting Known Failures only when CI fails
requiredBeforeEdit: Review invariant authority: SQ-AUTH-002, SQ-AUTH-009, SQ-AUTH-017

editRules.title: Browser-native dialog introduced into product workflow
editRules.message: Use Shoperation UI/modal authority instead of browser-native dialogs.

editRules.title: First-tenant fallback introduced
editRules.message: Resolve tenant/context explicitly; do not select the first tenant as fallback.

editRules.title: Host user-agent introduced as responsive authority
editRules.message: Responsive authority must come from the canonical viewport/workspace contract.

editRules.title: Fixed zoom/scale compensation added
editRules.message: Known failed approach: fixed zoom/scale may hide ownership/scroll geometry defects. Explicit exception required.

editRules.title: Width heuristic added directly in UI code
editRules.message: Confirm this is measurement input to the canonical responsive authority, not a second responsive controller.

editRules.title: Direct database mutation added in UI surface
editRules.message: Confirm the mutation uses the canonical governed authority and tenant boundary; explicit exception required.

editRules.title: Hard-coded business route added inside Template Factory authority
editRules.message: Confirm route convergence and shared business-route authority; explicit exception required.
